reason: Przycisk budowania nie leży w pasku menu po lewej stronie ekranu: w naszej grze to "Buduj", pierwszy z lewej na pasku na dole ekranu (klawisz B bez zmian). Miejsce budowy wskazuje się LEWYM przyciskiem myszy; prawy przycisk odwołuje stawianie budynku. Zbędny cudzysłów na końcu zdania (błąd autora).

lines.from: Click on the building symbol (house with hammer) in the menu bar on the left-hand side of the screen or press "b" on your keyboard, then select the farm from the list. The ground will then darken, except where it is possible to erect a farm. Click with the RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON on any light location of your choice. Your builders will pick a building site to work at on their own, but you can also assign them to particular constructions if necessary.
lines.to: Click the "Build" button (the first one on the left of the bar at the bottom of the screen) or press "b" on your keyboard, then select the farm from the list. The ground will then darken, except where it is possible to erect a farm. Click with the LEFT MOUSE BUTTON on any light location of your choice. Your builders will pick a building site to work at on their own, but you can also assign them to particular constructions if necessary.

lines.from: Build a well close to the place where you will build your bakery later on. There is still room directly in front of the headquarters. It's a nice spot and you can save building space for your really big buildings."
